head: 8c52b9f
major_results: ToolLevel accumulator/current/pending helpers traced in retail binary.
Ordinary upgrade thresholds proven: Copper 6000, Silver 18000, Gold 36000, Mystrile 65535.
Forge material ids proven: 0x12/0x13/0x14/0x15 request levels 1/2/3/4; Mythic Stone 0x1C requests level 5.
No fifth ordinary XP cutoff exists; extra Mythic prerequisites remain separate/unproven in this batch.
Forge transaction stages ToolLevel through func_0800EFB4 only when low three bits of selection field 0x48D8 are zero.
Forge commit consumes selected material held-first then rucksack fallback and debits stored transaction amount through func_0809ACC0.
notes: Call9 executed and counts but exited late because of a local analysis-script NameError after the important transaction evidence had already printed; it was intentionally not replayed under at-most-once policy.
